GraceDeployment.Target: Static HTML output rendered from this repository into html/aicc, mirrored by the aicc-deploy tool into the clean deployment repository /devops/websvc/websvc-ob-aicc (folder html/aicc), then pushed to its origin (GitHub) and websvc remotes; the websvc push triggers a server hook and Caddy serves the result
GraceDeployment.Notes: The maintained portal build composes AICC and its four independent neighbours into the same generated package. Freshness checks rebuild all five sections. Discovery content remains sourced from html-alt/financial-services. AI Lab projects the complete retained html-alt/cloudlab/index.html with matching Russian units under portal/sections/lab/ru/content.json; both sections package content and reading assets locally, with no runtime dependency on the predecessor folders. Portfolio is projected by portal/tools/portfolio.py from the maintained bilingual Registry, with role-safe summaries, source-state consistency checks and native initiatives/ routes. The three section entries remain under portal/sections; the renderer owns dashboard and summary output. Publication refreshes the progress view and does not change business state or expose closed evidence. The Projects front is projected by portal/tools/delivery.py from the maintained Program Backlog and Portfolio records, with bilingual board, intake and document views. The bounded INI-013 registration is a new Proposed intake observation, not a business approval or delivery admission. Explicit project mapping connects native documents and Initiative summaries; shared state remains in the Registry. The complete bilingual service-resolution project is projected from portfolio/{en,ru}/projects/service-resolution/workbook.html into projects/service-resolution/ and its eleven child document routes. Project text, diagrams, reading assets and search are bundled locally with no runtime dependency on html-alt. Deployment and portable export consume this complete output and preserve section-scoped search.

Internal URL http://hetzner-cx43.alpines-krait.ts.net/aicc/ and external URL https://aicc.hejihogusei.link/ behind Cloudflare Access; the allow-list was checked by the practitioner on 2026-09-29 and contains only the practitioner. Server side is owned by websvc-infra. Publishing is a deliberate act: aicc-deploy defaults to a dry run and pushes only with --publish. See deploy/README.md. A separate on-demand command, python3 portal/tools/export_portable.py, packages the generated website into portal/published for direct-file browsing from a copied folder or corporate share. Open aicc.html. Adding --static creates complete standalone portal/published/en and portal/published/ru editions, each with its own index.html and local assets, no JavaScript, light-only styling, native disclosures, topic links, visible view sections, inline source workflow descriptions and full-diagram files. Each language folder can be copied separately. This export is never refreshed automatically and does not publish the website; see portal/PORTABLE.md.
